evidence_basis: Low-confidence, unratified 72h research band around the captured ETH mark of 2,247.11. Persistent ETH/BTC closes below 0.0300 and negative depth imbalance support relative-weakness risk; the positive 24h ETH return and 72h recovery from the observed low counter a confirmed-breakdown reading. The band is a candidate for evaluation, not an execution threshold.
